content.title: Worthington Steel: Fiscal Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: COLUMBUS, Ohio (AP) — Worthington Steel (WS) on Wednesday reported profit of $18.8 million in its fiscal second quarter. The Columbus, Ohio-based company said it had profit of 37 cents per share. Earnings, adjusted for asset impairment costs and non-recurring costs, came to 38 cents per share.
